policy.image_reuse: Verify the license on each figure, check third-party exclusions, confirm appropriate patient permissions, retain source and attribution, and review intended commercial use before downloading or displaying any clinical photograph.
policy.measurement: Use standardized, same-person before/after photographs, compatible camera angles, expression and timing. Never treat observed deltas as an individual outcome guarantee.
